title: Creation's Echo

sources.title: Elemental Resonance
markers: | description = If the wielder deals {{DamageType|Acid}}, {{DamageType|Fire}}, {{DamageType|Lightning}}, {{DamageType|Radiant}}, or {{DamageType|Necrotic}} damage, it becomes resistant to that damage type for 2 turns.

summary: Qualifying damage against a creature grants resistance to the same damage type for 2 turns.

fields.Elemental Resonance: Acid, Fire, Lightning, Radiant or Necrotic damage against a creature grants matching resistance for 2 turns. Only one of these resistances can be active. The pinned source reports that it can replace an existing elixir.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence.
